chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Between the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and the seventh heaven is a place frequented by the angels."

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ السَّابِعَةِ: the seventh heaven; the highest celestial level mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, whose grave is the subject of the narration
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةِ: the angels, who are described as frequenting this path or space
key_terms.قَبْرِ: grave; the burial place being described as spiritually significant
key_terms.مُخْتَلَفُ: a place of frequent coming and going

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the space between the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and the seventh heaven?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a special heavenly connection between the قبر of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and the highest celestial realm mentioned here, indicating the sanctity of his resting place. It conveys that the site is one of continual passage and attendance by the angels.
